settingsview.about.architecture: how the code of this workspace is laid out
settingsview.about.style: the colours and symbols of this interface, yours alone
settingsview.about.forms: guided forms that run a smith command
settingsview.sections.title: Sections
settingsview.detail.more: … {count} more lines: make the window taller
settingsview.unavailable: The settings of this workspace are not available here.
settingsview.reason.editor: finish or cancel the editor first (Esc)
settingsview.reason.sections: the list of sections has the keys
settingsview.reason.listed: this one is only listed: smith.toml says which plugins and recipes are used
settingsview.reason.select.trust: select an external plugin to trust
settingsview.reason.select.forget: select an external plugin that is trusted
settingsview.reason.select.unset: select a setting to reset to its default
settingsview.reason.default: this setting already has its default
settingsview.preview.title: Preview
settingsview.preview.saved: Saved for you alone in {path}; smith.toml is not touched.
settingsview.preview.wins: {variable} is set, so it wins over this choice: unset it to see the effect.
settingsview.editor.trust.title: Trust {name}?
settingsview.install.title: Install a plugin
settingsview.install.about: A plugin directory or archive, an https URL or github:owner/repo@tag. An archive or URL also needs its sha256: type it after the source.
settingsview.search.title: Find a plugin in the marketplace
settingsview.search.about: Words from the name, the description, the roles or the languages (for example: deploy go). Leave it empty to list every plugin.
settingsview.install.missing: Say where the plugin comes from.
settingsview.error.unavailable: this smith cannot do that here
settingsview.busy.unstoppable: That change is being saved and cannot be stopped: it ends in a moment
settingsview.architecture.confirm: {name} would check none of your projects. Enter again to choose it anyway.
settingsview.note.installed: Installed here; a workspace uses it when smith.toml declares it under [plugins.external].
settingsview.note.recipe: Recipes are chosen in smith.toml ([workspace] recipe); smith recipe check <file> checks one.
settingsview.theme.plain: no colour: bold and reverse carry the meaning
settingsview.icons.auto: unicode, unless the terminal cannot draw it
settingsview.icons.ascii: [v] [x] [!] and a plain spinner, for terminals without unicode
settingsview.row.search: + Find a plugin in the marketplace…
settingsview.summary.plugin: Enter or Space turns {name} on or off
settingsview.summary.external: Enter reviews it before you trust it
settingsview.summary.architecture: Enter chooses it and saves it in smith.toml
settingsview.empty.recipes: No recipe files (*.recipe.toml) in this workspace. A recipe is a team's choice of plugins and settings; smith recipe check <file> checks one. Write one with Write a recipe in the Guide tab, or press : and search for recipe.
settingsview.plugin.support: support for a language, built into smith
settingsview.plugin.about: Enter or Space turns it on or off for this workspace and saves smith.toml at once; at least one must stay on. Projects in a language that is off are not built, tested or checked.
settingsview.plugin.addons: Tools that are always on: {tools}. The same as: smith plugin enable|disable {name}
settingsview.external.trusted: {state}. Enter reviews it again, f forgets the decision (smith plugin untrust).
settingsview.external.untrusted: {state}: smith will not start it. Enter shows what it is, then trusts it (smith plugin trust). {detail}
settingsview.installed.about: A workspace starts it when smith.toml declares it under [plugins.external.{name}].
settingsview.install.from: From a directory, an archive, an https URL or a GitHub release: smith plugin install <source>.
settingsview.install.detail: Enter asks where it comes from and shows the command line. After you confirm it, it runs in the Run view. The plugin is checked, never started, and trusted only when you say so here.
settingsview.search.from: Type a word (deploy, go, scaffold) or leave it empty to list every plugin. smith searches the marketplace and lets you pick one.
settingsview.search.detail: The one you pick is installed with smith plugin install, after a confirmation that shows the command line. It is checked, never started, and trusted only when you say so here.
settingsview.architecture.about: The architecture is how the code of this workspace is laid out. smith checks that the code follows the one you choose, and the check fails when it does not.
settingsview.architecture.enter: Enter chooses it and saves it at once: it {writes}. Choose none to stop the checks.
settingsview.setting.keys.reset: Enter changes it, u resets it to its default
settingsview.recipe.check: smith recipe check {path} shows what it would use and where each value came from.
settingsview.form.about: Enter opens the form; it ends as a smith command line.
settingsview.keys.install: Enter shows the command · Esc cancels
settingsview.keys.multi: Space ticks · Enter saves · Esc cancels
settingsview.keys.review: y trust · p trust and pin the sha256 for CI · Esc cancels
settingsview.keys.review.again: y trusts it again · p also pins the sha256 for CI · f forgets it · Esc closes
